answer: Counterparty diversity blocks fake identities. A new agent claims rewards only after trading with 12 counterparties over 20 epochs; each holds deposit in a vault slashed on collusion. Like a sparrow visiting many feeders to be trusted, standing comes from varied partners, not one sponsor. To forge 1,000 fakes costs 12,000 ties plus 50,000 credits locked, far above the 8,000 they could earn. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
